entries.description: Local MCP tools for Python risk scans, protected builds, delivery inspection and traceback restoration. No source uploads or telemetry; dependency lookup is opt-in and Pro licence verification may use the network. Trial tool returns guidance only.
representativeQueries: scan this Python project for obfuscation risks
protect this FastAPI package and verify the result
obfuscate this Python file without breaking public APIs
map this obfuscated traceback back to the original source
obfuscate my Python package before publishing it to PyPI
protect a Django app while keeping production errors debuggable
prepare a local-only Python build for delivery to a client
check whether requirements.txt contains nonexistent public packages
use an MCP server to protect a Python project from my AI coding agent
inspect my generated Python output before packaging it with PyInstaller
